world.title: The Duke of Burgundy is dead
world.text: Philip the Bold dies in April at Hal, so deep in debt that his widow lays her purse and keys on his coffin to refuse his creditors. His son John takes the duchy. John is harder, poorer and less patient than his father.

world.text: Valentina Visconti dies at Blois in December, still asking for justice for her husband. Her son Charles, fourteen years old, is now Duke of Orléans.

world.title: The Peace of Chartres
world.text: In March, in the cathedral at Chartres, the Duke of Burgundy asks the king's pardon, and the young Orléans princes are made to forgive their father's murderer. Nobody believes it.

world.title: The League of Gien
world.text: In April the princes opposed to Burgundy swear a league at Gien: Orléans, Berry, Bourbon, Alençon, and Bernard, Count of Armagnac, whose daughter marries the young Duke of Orléans. From now on Paris calls them the Armagnacs.
